an4.49:1.3: Anicce bhikkhave niccan ti saññāvipallāso cittavipallāso diṭṭhivipallāso,
an4.49:1.4: adukkhe bhikkhave dukkhan ti saññāvipallāso cittavipallāso diṭṭhivipallāso,
an4.49:1.5: anattani bhikkhave attā ti saññāvipallāso . . . diṭṭhivipāllaso,
an4.49:1.6: asubhe bhikkhave subhan ti saññāvipallāso cittavipallāso diṭṭhivipallāso.
an4.49:1.7: Ime kho bhikkhave cattāro saññāvipallāsā cittavipallāsā diṭṭhivipallāsā. 2.
an4.49:2.1: Cattāro 'me bhikkhave na saññāvipallāsā na cittavipallāsā, na diṭṭhivipallāsā.
an4.49:2.3: Anicce bhikkhave aniccan ti na saññāvipallāso . . .,
an4.49:2.4: dukkhe bhikkhave dukkhan ti na saññāvipallāso . . .,
an4.49:2.5: anattani bhikkhave anattā ti na saññāvipallāso . . .,
an4.49:2.6: asubhe bhikkhave asubhan ti na saññāvipallāso na cittavipallāso na diṭṭhivipallāso.
an4.49:2.7: Ime kho bhikkhave cattāro na saññāvipallāsā na cittavipallāsā na diṭṭhivipallāsāti. 3.
